from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet

from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
from ghidra.program.flatapi import FlatProgramAPI
from java.util import ArrayList
p=currentProgram
fm=p.getFunctionManager()
api=FlatProgramAPI(p,monitor)
af=p.getAddressFactory()
def a(x): return af.getAddress(x.removeprefix("0x"))
rows=[dict(start="0x1407fcc80",end="0x1407fdb6d")]
result=[]
for row in rows:
 f=fm.getFunctionAt(a(row["start"]))
 di=DecompInterface();di.openProgram(p)
 d=di.decompileFunction(f,60,monitor)
 result.append(dict(address=row["start"],completed=d.decompileCompleted(),error=str(d.getErrorMessage()),gz=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(d.getDecompiledFunction().getC().encode())).decode() if d.decompileCompleted() else None))
 di.dispose()
